findings.message: msg:sdp handler missing try-catch wrapper - unhandled promise rejections will cause silent connection failures
findings.triggering_path: When setRemoteDescription(), setLocalDescription(), or roomClient.send() throw due to invalid SDP, incompatible codecs, state mismatch, or network failure
findings.consequence: User sees no error explanation, isSettingRemoteAnswerPending flag stuck, connection appears hung with no diagnostic info
findings.suggestion: Wrap the entire async handler body in try-catch block. In catch block: (1) log error with context, (2) reset isSettingRemoteAnswerPending to false, (3) optionally emit connection-error event. Follow the pattern used in onnegotiationneeded (lines 70-81) and createOffer (lines 188-199) which both have try-catch-finally.
